com.google.android.feedback.description: Google's feedback and crash reporter, which sends reports to Google. Nothing on the TV depends on it.

com.google.android.play.games.description: Google Play Games, the profile and achievements app. Only games that sign in with Play Games need it.

com.google.android.videos.description: Google's movie and TV store (Play Movies, later the Google TV app). Disable only if you don't buy or rent films from Google: purchases and that library stop opening.

com.google.android.tvrecommendations.description: Fills the recommendation rows on the stock home screen. Disabling it empties those rows; on an NVIDIA SHIELD testers keep it enabled, and some firmware turns it back on.

com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic.description: YouTube Music. Disable only if you don't play music with it.

com.google.android.partnersetup.description: Google Partner Setup: tells Google which partner shipped the TV (referral and attribution pings). Nothing you use depends on it.

com.google.android.katniss.description: Google Assistant and voice search. Disable only if you don't use voice: the remote's microphone button stops working.

com.google.android.syncadapters.calendar.description: Syncs Google Calendar in the background. TVs have no calendar app that uses it.

com.android.printspooler.description: Android's print service. A TV has nothing to print from.

com.google.android.backdrop.description: Ambient Mode, Google's photo screensaver. Pick another screensaver in Settings first, or the TV has none.

com.android.tv.feedbackconsent.description: The prompt that asks whether to share feedback and diagnostics. Nothing depends on it.

com.tcl.esticker.description: TCL's retail-demo sticker: the energy-label and feature overlay shown on store display sets.

com.google.android.marvin.talkback.description: TalkBack, the screen reader. Disable only if nobody in the home needs spoken feedback.

com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom.description: Prime Video. Disable only if you don't watch Prime Video; the app, and any Prime Video button on the remote, stop working.

com.android.adservices.api.description: Android's ad services (Privacy Sandbox: Topics and ad attribution). Nothing you watch depends on it.

com.google.android.onetimeinitializer.description: A task that runs once after first setup and does nothing afterwards.

com.tcl.messagebox.description: TCL's pushed messages and promos. Several testers keep it because it also carries a TCL system receiver; disable it only after checking the rest of the TV still works.

com.android.ondevicepersonalization.serv.description: Android's on-device ad personalisation service, part of Privacy Sandbox. Nothing you watch depends on it.

com.tcl.waterfall.overseas.description: "TCL Channel", TCL's web feed of film and show recommendations.

com.android.federatedcompute.services.description: Federated learning for Android's ad and usage services. Nothing you watch depends on it.

com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx.description: Google TV's Ambient Mode screensaver, which mixes in recommendations. Switch to another screensaver in Settings first, or the TV has none.

com.google.android.tv.bugreportsender.description: Uploads bug reports to Google automatically. Nothing on the TV depends on it.

com.tcl.usercenter.description: TCL account sign-in. Disable only if you don't use TCL services; some TCL firmware turns it back on at every boot.

fusion.android.tv.demo.description: The retail store demo. On some MediaTek-based TVs the same package handles the remote's Input button, so after disabling it check that Input still opens the source menu.

com.tcl.partnercustomizer.description: TCL's promo rows on the Google TV home screen. On some models it also carries the remote's TKey or Inputs button, so check those still work.

com.google.android.apps.mediashell.description: Chromecast built-in. Disable only if you never cast from a phone or laptop: casting to the TV stops working.

com.tcl.guard.description: TGuard, TCL's cleaner and app manager. It runs as a persistent system app with an installer service, so test the TV after disabling it.

android.autoinstalls.config.google.gtvpa.description: Rules that let the Play Store silently install partner apps. Disabling it stops those auto-installs.

com.tcl.tv.tclhome_passive.description: Pushes TCL content onto the home screen at boot.

com.tcl.bi.description: TCL's analytics service (usage statistics, crash and network reporting).

com.tcl.smartalexa.description: TCL's Alexa bridge. Disable only if you don't control the TV with Alexa; some TCL firmware turns it back on at boot.

com.tcl.ui_mediaCenter.description: TCL's USB and DLNA media player. Disable only if you never play files from a USB drive or home server.

com.xm.webcontent.description: Xiaomi's web container for promotions shown on PatchWall.

com.miui.tv.analytics.description: Xiaomi's TV analytics: collects app usage and logs.

com.netflix.ninja.description: Netflix. Disable only if you don't watch Netflix: the app and the remote's Netflix button stop working.

com.tcl.channelplus.description: TCL's free ad-supported (FAST) channels. Disabling it also removes them from Live TV, so keep it if you watch them.

com.qterics.da.product.description: Qterics device agent on Sony TVs: background telemetry for the manufacturer.

com.sony.dtv.da.service.description: Sony's device agent and remote-support service. Re-enable it if Sony support asks to connect to the TV.

com.sony.dtv.sonyselect.description: Sony Select, Sony's app recommendation tile and promos.

com.tcl.logkit.description: TCL's log collector, which captures and uploads logs.

com.tcl.ocean.instructions.description: TCL's on-screen e-manual and first-run tips.

com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.reco.description: Recommendation rows for the older Android TV home screen. On some models it is tied to the TV's inputs, so check HDMI and Live TV still work after disabling it.

com.tcl.dashboard.description: The "TCL Home" panel with its gift box and promo messages. Some owners keep it for the TCL Home tile.

com.google.android.tts.description: Google text-to-speech. Disable only if nobody uses TalkBack or spoken answers: they stop talking.

com.google.android.tv.assistant.description: Google Assistant for TV (voice and the Assistant light). Disable only if you don't use voice: the remote's microphone search stops working.

com.mstar.android.tv.disclaimercustomiza.description: Disclaimer screens used by first-run setup and retail mode. On laser projectors it may show the laser safety notice, so keep it there.

tv.samba.ssm.description: Samba TV: automatic content recognition that fingerprints what is on screen to build viewing data.

com.sony.dtv.smarthelp.description: Sony's Smart Help tile. Keep it if you use the on-TV help.
